/kind failing-test 

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

These tests pull a multi-arch image list and hardcode amd64 as the    architecture of the selected instance. On any other host (e.g. aarch64)    buildah correctly picks the host architecture, so the assertion fails:

```
  expected: =~ 'amd64'
    actual:    'arm64'
```

Compare against the host architecture reported by `buildah info`   instead.

Otherwise tests fail on aarch64 in openQA:
https://openqa.opensuse.org/tests/6304544/logfile?filename=buildah-buildah-root.tap.txt
